# Test fixtures

- `spans.json`: literal source-span cases for `inspect` (Unicode, tabs, BOM,
  LF/CRLF, headings, fences, lists, quotes, HTML, GFM tables). Each case names
  the blocks it expects by kind and exact source text.
- `markstay/tree-parse52.json` and `markstay/spec-hash.json`: copied unchanged
  from the markstay conformance corpus (the §5.2 tree tier and §8 hash
  vectors). Refresh them only with the pinned spec.
- `markstay/reference-children.json`: generated by `markstay/generate.py` from
  the markstay Python reference linter in CommonMark child-block mode. It
  records the markstay revision and the SHA-256 of `SPEC.md` it came from, and
  `markstay_conformance.rs` pins that hash. Regenerate with
  `MARKSTAY_REPO=/path/to/markstay python3 markstay/generate.py` (needs
  markdown-it-py) only when the pinned spec changes.

All content is synthetic.
